title: C# Arrays
description: Arrays are used to store multiple values in a single variable.

challenges.title: Create Array
challenges.exercise: Create an array of strings named 'cars' with 'Volvo', 'BMW'. Print cars[0].

challenges.title: Access Element
challenges.exercise: Print the second element of 'cars' (Volvo, BMW).

challenges.title: Array Length
challenges.exercise: Print the number of elements in the cars array using Length.

challenges.title: Change Value
challenges.exercise: Change 'Volvo' to 'Opel' and print the first element.

challenges.title: Sort Array
challenges.exercise: Use Array.Sort() on an array {2, 1} and print the first element.
